name: Wild Lettuce
caution: Eat the young leaves; older plants turn very bitter. A safe wild ancestor of garden lettuce. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A tall lettuce with milky sap and leaves that clasp the stem, often with a row of prickles down the midrib underneath.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Young rosette leaves eat like a sharp lettuce; cook the bitterness out of older ones as you would dandelion.
